xna-type.name: RacingCameraAngle
xna-type.summary: Indicates which camera angle this gamer prefers to use in racing games.

member.name: Back
member.summary: Traditional third-person camera view from behind the car.

member.name: Front
member.summary: Camera view from in front of the car. The car itself is not visible.

member.name: Inside
member.summary: Camera view from inside the car, looking through the windscreen.
